facts.name: government_training_institutions_total
facts.definition: Total training institutions in the governmental sector, systematic and unsystematic education.
limitations: Official education and training supply statistic; not demand for a specific private or online offer.
Historical period; do not use as current market size or advertising benchmark.

facts.name: government_students_total
facts.definition: Total students in governmental-sector training institutions, systematic and unsystematic education.
limitations: Official participation statistic; not addressable audience size or demand signal for advertising.
Historical period; retain the source period and definition.

facts.name: government_graduates_total
facts.definition: Total graduates in governmental-sector training institutions, systematic and unsystematic education.
limitations: Official graduate count; not enrollment conversion, lead quality, or outcome benchmark.
Historical period; not a current market forecast.

facts.name: government_and_ministry_social_solidarity_training_institutions_total
facts.tableReference: Government and Ministry of Social Solidarity private-sector table
facts.definition: Combined total shown in the bulletin for governmental and Ministry of Social Solidarity private-sector training institutions.
limitations: The combined table has a specific institutional scope; it is not the total Egyptian education market.
Historical period and source-specific definition must remain attached.

facts.name: government_data_source_response_rate
facts.definition: Response rate reported for governmental sources in the bulletin methodology.
limitations: Quality metadata for the bulletin, not an education demand or advertising metric.
Do not generalize the response rate to other sectors or current periods.

facts.name: private_data_source_response_rate
facts.definition: Response rate reported for the private-sector sources affiliated with the Ministry of Social Solidarity.
limitations: Quality metadata for the bulletin, not an education demand or advertising metric.
Do not generalize the response rate to all private education providers.
